readiness.summary: Clean installation, lint, build, 121 E2E tests, and MCP stdio/HTTP smoke reached executable CI gates.
Statement coverage is 66.14% against the normative 80% threshold.
Documentation, bilingual parity, semantic tracking, maturity reconciliation, and machine-contract validation pass with full commit history.

Release pipeline defects resolved in code (GT-44, commit 26f6a18): event-correct version checks that skip ordinary main pushes, package.json-derived package and binary identity, pinned pkg with deterministic per-target binaries uploaded/downloaded/executed/attached, blocking init and version smoke, and a safely degrading failure notifier. The definitive green release-pipeline run is pending the next release-triggering push.
